2
Yɛafiri owuo mu aba nkwa mu
1 # Kol 2.13 Na mo a anka moyɛ awufoɔ wɔ mfomsoɔ ne bɔne mu, 2#Tito 3.3; Efe 6.12; Yoh 12.31 na akane no monantee sɛdeɛ wiase abrabɔ teɛ ne sɛdeɛ ewiem tumi no panin no teɛ, honhom a nnansa yi ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ wɔn a wɔyɛ asoɔden mu no.
3 # Kol 3.6 Wɔn mu na anka akane no, yɛn nyinaa nso nam bɔɔ yɛn bra yɛn honam akɔnnɔ mu, na yɛyɛɛ deɛ honam ne adwene pɛ, na sɛdeɛ yɛn awosuo teɛ no yɛyɛ nnipa a Onyankopɔn abufuo wɔ yɛn so, te sɛ wɔn a aka no nso. 4Nanso Onyankopɔn a ne mmɔborɔhunu dɔɔso no nam ne dɔ bebree a ɔde dɔ yɛn no so 5#Luka 15.24; 15.32 ama yɛn a anka yɛyɛ awufoɔ wɔ mfomsoɔ mu no ne Kristo anya nkwa, (adom na wɔde agye mo nkwa.) 6#Rom 8.10; Flp 3.20 Na wanyane yɛn ne no, na ɔde yɛn ne no atena soro hɔnom, Kristo Yesu mu, 7#Efe 1.7 sɛ wiase a ɛreba no mu ɔbɛyi n’adom ahonya a ɛboro soɔ no adi wɔ ayamyɛ a ɔyɛ yɛn Kristo Yesu mu mu.
8 # Gal 2.16 Na adom na wɔde nam gyidie so agye mo nkwa, ɛmfiri mo ara, ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn akyɛdeɛ, 9#1 Ko 1.29 ɛmfiri nnwuma mu, na obiara anhoahoa ne ho. 10#Tito 2.14 Na yɛyɛ n’adwinneɛ a ɔyɛeɛ, ɔbɔɔ yɛn Kristo Yesu mu maa nnwuma pa a Onyankopɔn asiesie ato hɔ sɛ yɛnnante mu no.
Wɔayɛ yɛn baako wɔ Kristo mu
11 # Efe 5.8 Enti monkae sɛ, mo a anka kane no moyɛ amanaman mufoɔ honam fam, na wɔn a wɔfrɛ wɔn ho twetiatwafoɔ, mekyerɛ wɔn a wɔde nsa ara kɛkɛ twa honam mu no frɛ mo momonoto no, 12#Rom 9.4 monkae sɛ da bi no na mo ne Kristo nni twaka biara, na na moyɛ ananafoɔ a wɔnyɛ Israel man mma, ne ahɔhoɔ wɔ bɔhyɛ apam ahodoɔ no ho, na monni anidasoɔ biara, na monni Onyankopɔn bi wɔ wiase. 13Na afei deɛ, Kristo Yesu mu, mo a anka mowɔ akyirikyiri no, monam Kristo mogya mu abɛn.
14 # Yes 9.5; Gal 3.28 Na ɔno ara ankasa ne yɛn asomdwoeɛ, wayɛ baanu no baako, na wadwiri ɔfasuo a ɛtwa yɛn ntam a ɛne nitan no, 15#Kol 2.14; 2 Ko 5.17 ɛfiri sɛ ɔde ne honam yii mmara a ɛnam nsɛm ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ ahyɛdeɛ mu no hɔ, na ɔde wɔn baanu nyinaa abɔ onipa foforɔ baako, ɔno ara ne mu, ama asomdwoeɛ aba, 16na wafa asɛnnua no so apata aka baanu no abɔ Nyankopɔn ho, nipadua baako mu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnam asɛnnua no ara so akum nitan no. 17#Yes 57.19; Sak 9.10 Na ɔba bɛkaa asomdwoeɛ ho asɛmpa kyerɛɛ mo a mowɔ akyiri ne wɔn a wɔbɛn, 18#Efe 3.12 ɛfiri sɛ ne so na yɛn baanu nyinaa nam honhom baako mu anya kwan kɔ Agya no nkyɛn.
19 # Efe 3.6; Heb 12.22-23 Enti afei monyɛ ahɔhoɔ ne amamfrafoɔ bio, na mmom moyɛ ahotefoɔ no yɔnko-man-mma ne Nyankopɔn fiefoɔ. 20#Mat 16.18; Yes 28.16 Wɔde mo asi asomafoɔ ne adiyifoɔ fapem a Kristo Yesu no ara ne tweaso tiboɔ titire no so. 21Ne mu na deɛ wɔasie no nyinaa akeka atoa mu, na ɛrepagya akɔyɛ asɔredan kronkron Awurade mu; 22#1 Pe 2.5 ne mu na wɔde mo nso resi akɔyɛ Nyankopɔn tenabea, honhom mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na mo a anka moyɛ awufoɔ wɔ mfomsoɔ ne bɔne mu, na akane no monantee sɛdeɛ wiase abrabɔ teɛ ne sɛdeɛ ewiem tumi no panin no teɛ, honhom a nnansa yi ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ wɔn a wɔyɛ asoɔden mu no.
Wɔn mu na anka akane no, yɛn nyinaa nso nam bɔɔ yɛn bra yɛn honam akɔnnɔ mu, na yɛyɛɛ deɛ honam ne adwene pɛ, na sɛdeɛ yɛn awosuo teɛ no yɛyɛ nnipa a Onyankopɔn abufuo wɔ yɛn so, te sɛ wɔn a aka no nso. Nanso Onyankopɔn a ne mmɔborɔhunu dɔɔso no nam ne dɔ bebree a ɔde dɔ yɛn no so ama yɛn a anka yɛyɛ awufoɔ wɔ mfomsoɔ mu no ne Kristo anya nkwa, (adom na wɔde agye mo nkwa.) Na wanyane yɛn ne no, na ɔde yɛn ne no atena soro hɔnom, Kristo Yesu mu, sɛ wiase a ɛreba no mu ɔbɛyi n’adom ahonya a ɛboro soɔ no adi wɔ ayamyɛ a ɔyɛ yɛn Kristo Yesu mu mu.
Na adom na wɔde nam gyidie so agye mo nkwa, ɛmfiri mo ara, ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn akyɛdeɛ, ɛmfiri nnwuma mu, na obiara anhoahoa ne ho. Na yɛyɛ n’adwinneɛ a ɔyɛeɛ, ɔbɔɔ yɛn Kristo Yesu mu maa nnwuma pa a Onyankopɔn asiesie ato hɔ sɛ yɛnnante mu no.

Enti monkae sɛ, mo a anka kane no moyɛ amanaman mufoɔ honam fam, na wɔn a wɔfrɛ wɔn ho twetiatwafoɔ, mekyerɛ wɔn a wɔde nsa ara kɛkɛ twa honam mu no frɛ mo momonoto no, monkae sɛ da bi no na mo ne Kristo nni twaka biara, na na moyɛ ananafoɔ a wɔnyɛ Israel man mma, ne ahɔhoɔ wɔ bɔhyɛ apam ahodoɔ no ho, na monni anidasoɔ biara, na monni Onyankopɔn bi wɔ wiase. Na afei deɛ, Kristo Yesu mu, mo a anka mowɔ akyirikyiri no, monam Kristo mogya mu abɛn.
Na ɔno ara ankasa ne yɛn asomdwoeɛ, wayɛ baanu no baako, na wadwiri ɔfasuo a ɛtwa yɛn ntam a ɛne nitan no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔde ne honam yii mmara a ɛnam nsɛm ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ ahyɛdeɛ mu no hɔ, na ɔde wɔn baanu nyinaa abɔ onipa foforɔ baako, ɔno ara ne mu, ama asomdwoeɛ aba, na wafa asɛnnua no so apata aka baanu no abɔ Nyankopɔn ho, nipadua baako mu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnam asɛnnua no ara so akum nitan no. Na ɔba bɛkaa asomdwoeɛ ho asɛmpa kyerɛɛ mo a mowɔ akyiri ne wɔn a wɔbɛn, ɛfiri sɛ ne so na yɛn baanu nyinaa nam honhom baako mu anya kwan kɔ Agya no nkyɛn.
Enti afei monyɛ ahɔhoɔ ne amamfrafoɔ bio, na mmom moyɛ ahotefoɔ no yɔnko-man-mma ne Nyankopɔn fiefoɔ. Wɔde mo asi asomafoɔ ne adiyifoɔ fapem a Kristo Yesu no ara ne tweaso tiboɔ titire no so. Ne mu na deɛ wɔasie no nyinaa akeka atoa mu, na ɛrepagya akɔyɛ asɔredan kronkron Awurade mu; ne mu na wɔde mo nso resi akɔyɛ Nyankopɔn tenabea, honhom mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
